review.notes: All 27 physical pages compared against the OCR Markdown with a normalized full-text diff plus a whole-document numeric multiset check (digit runs compared with matching multiplicity; residual deltas were printed page numbers, the arXiv stamp, figure-internal diagram labels on p.4/p.8, and footnote URLs, all accounted for). No unbalanced code fences (0 fence blocks); heading tree matches the printed sections including the Contributors subsections. The PDF is digital-native so its text layer is authoritative; the printed typo 'secoond' (p.11) and abstract typo 'performacne' (p.2) are kept as printed. Pages 1, 7, 10, 11, 21 and 22 were additionally rendered to visually verify every patch below, including all nine restored footnote URL bodies and the reference author-list repairs.
